**Big but shallow. 1082 hits, 94 files.** Most is service internals.

Four places must keep `account_id`:

| Where | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | 5 | frozen public contract |
| [migrations/](migrations) | 37 | applied history, breaks down steps |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk](vendor/reporting-sdk/src/client.js) | 12 | generated, do not edit |
| SQL strings in `repo/*.js` | 125 | live DB column |

[lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) maps internal to wire. Rename the key, not the value.

Next: sign off with those four carved out.
